title: Compress and Forget: bitsandbytes Quantization Amplifies Proactive Interference in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.18578v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Proactive interference (PI) is a documented failure mode in large language models in which retrieval of a repeatedly overwritten value degrades as prior overwrites accumulate, mirroring a classical phenomenon in human working memory. Post-training quantization (PTQ) is now the default deployment path for open-weight models, yet its effect on this failure mode has not been tested. We evaluate three precision levels (FP16, INT8, INT4/NF4, via bitsandbytes) across three architecturally distinct instruction-tuned models (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, Phi-3.5-mini-instruct), holding the retrieval task fixed. INT4 quantization significantly reduces accuracy under high interference in every model (e.g., from 81.0% to 68.3% for Qwen), confirmed by paired McNemar's tests ($p \le 2.6 \times 10^{-6}$) and a mixed-effects regression spanning all interference levels; INT8, often assumed safe, also carries a smaller but real penalty i

translated_title: 压缩与遗忘：bitsandbytes量化加剧大语言模型中的主动性干扰
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18578v1 公告类型：新公告 摘要：主动性干扰（PI）是大语言模型中一个已被记录的性能缺陷，即当重复覆盖的值被检索时，其准确性会随着先前覆盖的累积而下降，这反映了人类工作记忆中的经典现象。训练后量化（PTQ）现在是开放权重模型默认的部署路径，但其对这种缺陷的影响尚未被测试。我们通过bitsandbytes评估了三种精度水平（FP16、INT8、INT4/NF4），涵盖三个架构不同的指令调优模型（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3、Phi-3.5-mini-instruct），并保持检索任务固定。INT4量化在高干扰条件下显著降低了每个模型的准确性（例如，Qwen从81.0%降至68.3%），通过配对McNemar检验（$p \le 2.6 \times 10^{-6}$）和覆盖所有干扰水平的混合效应回归确认；INT8虽然通常被认为是安全的，但也带来了较小但真实的性能损失。
tldr: 研究发现，训练后量化（尤其是INT4）显著加剧了大语言模型在高干扰条件下的主动性干扰，导致检索准确性大幅下降，而INT8也有较小但不可忽视的影响。
en_tdlr: The study reveals that post-training quantization, especially INT4, significantly amplifies proactive interference in large language models under high interference, causing substantial retrieval accuracy drops, while INT8 also has a smaller but non-negligible impact.
